checksums.description: Additive byte checksum: FUN_080011dc sums save[0..span) and stores at span end; FUN_08001244 recomputes and compares. Verified: sum(logical[0:0x137]) & 0xFF = 0xF4 = logical[0x137].
checksums.name: save_checksum

fields.description: 15-byte save magic verified by the load routine
fields.evidence: FUN_08001244 loads 0x27 EEPROM blocks via FUN_080260a0 into the RAM mirror and compares save bytes 0x00-0x0E (loop bound 0xE) against ROM; baseline holds ASCII SAVE_FLOWERSHOP.
fields.name: save_magic

fields.description: Persistent save-state flags; individual bits set/cleared around garden and save/load flows
fields.evidence: FUN_08003f94 sets bits 0x4000/0x2000 at +0x10 then calls FUN_080011dc; FUN_08016ed8 sets 0x2000 at +0x10 before FUN_080011dc; FUN_0800fe7c tests bit 0x100 and FUN_08005bc4 restores bit 0x100 after FUN_08001244; new-game init clears bit 0. Baseline +0x10 = 0x4000.
fields.name: save_flags

fields.description: Shop name as four little-endian u16 glyph units (Shift-JIS codes 82CF/8160/82B5/82E1)
fields.evidence: Bytes +0x14..+0x1B decode as LE u16 units spelling hiragana shop name directly after the magic; span is written by FUN_080011dc and verified by FUN_08001244. No dedicated writer identified.
fields.name: shop_name

fields.description: Small persistent counter of unknown meaning; live value 5
fields.evidence: Non-blank u16 inside the checksummed span written by FUN_080011dc and verified by FUN_08001244; no dedicated save-struct writer identified in decomp.
fields.name: prog_var_20

fields.description: Small persistent counter of unknown meaning; live value 7
fields.evidence: Non-blank u16 inside the checksummed span written by FUN_080011dc and verified by FUN_08001244; no dedicated save-struct writer identified in decomp.
fields.name: prog_var_22

fields.description: Accumulating gameplay counter (earnings-like); new-game default 15, live 0
fields.evidence: New-game default 0xF written at +0x26 by FUN_08003f94 and FUN_08005bc4; gameplay copy from live state into +0x26 in FUN_0800fe7c; baseline 0.
fields.name: shop_funds

fields.description: Selected garden cell index consumed by the plant routine and preserved across reloads
fields.evidence: FUN_0800fe7c uses +0x2A as a cell index into the +0xB0 garden grid (bit set at save+0x122+(+0x2A), then cleared); FUN_08005bc4 preserves +0x2A across the FUN_08001244 reload; baseline 0.
fields.name: cursor_cell

fields.description: Pending garden action; value 3 triggers the plant sequence, then cleared
fields.evidence: FUN_0800fe7c runs the plant path when +0x2C==3 with flag bit 0x100 set and +0x2A!=0, then clears +0x2A/+0x2C; new-game default 0 in FUN_08003f94/FUN_08005bc4; baseline 0.
fields.name: garden_action

fields.description: Garden bed cell states: low 2 bits are the planted item id, bit 0x10 is the growth/watered flag
fields.evidence: FUN_08003f94 stores (rand & 3) into save+0xB0[i] for 0x75 cells; FUN_08005bc4 clears 0x80 bytes at +0xB0; FUN_0800fe7c sets/tests bit 0x10 and the low nibble per cell; FUN_08016ed8 plants (+0xB0)[cell]=value with index bound <0x76 then calls FUN_080011dc; baseline values are all 0-3.
fields.name: garden_beds

fields.description: Fixed 7-character ASCII footer tag; constant in this capture
fields.evidence: Bytes +0x130..+0x136 read ' FALSE ' inside the checksum span; no gameplay writer found (ROM-default constant on the FUN_08001184 init path); baseline exact match.
fields.name: footer_tag
